scenario: A life-insurance carrier's adjudication pipeline processes a life-insurance claim for a policyholder who died. The policy includes an Accidental Death and Dismemberment (AD&D) rider that doubles the face amount when death results from an accident rather than illness. The pipeline: (1) extracts cause-of-death text and supporting documents from the claim file PDF, (2) classifies the cause of death and determines AD&D rider applicability using ICD-10 coding logic, and (3) produces a claim determination memo that calculates the payable benefit amount.
info_flow: pdf-extract reads the claim file PDF and outputs raw text including cause-of-death fields and supporting documentation → icd10-cpt-coding-assistant classifies the cause of death with ICD-10 codes and determines whether the death qualifies as accidental for AD&D rider purposes → afrexai-insurance-claims produces the formal claim determination memo citing the applicable benefit amount based on the rider applicability determination.
